_how: Edit `status` to `published` (and set `published_on`, YYYY-MM-DD), then run:  python3 articles/publish.py  — it sets noindex/index on each page, adds or removes the DRAFT banner, rebuilds the hub list, and rewrites the article entries in sitemap.xml. Drafts stay reachable by direct URL for review but are not listed, not indexed, and not in the sitemap.
